recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not re-add encounter-primaryDiagnosis or force the old Encounter.indication shape; any new need for non-billing primary/secondary diagnosis ranking should be handled by a new PA issue rather than as an unapplied FHIR-7906 gap.
issue_request: FHIR-7906 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration DSTU1 issue asking Encounter to represent which conditions or diagnoses were related to an encounter, with role information for concepts such as principal, working, preliminary, confirmed, and final diagnoses; its 2015 resolution constrained Encounter.indication to Condition or Procedure and proposed a positiveInt primary diagnosis sequence extension.
initial_application: The seed was initially applied by git commit 0983925cea, which explicitly listed tracker 7906 and added the old Encounter.indication constraint plus encounter-primaryDiagnosis extension comments/examples. Later commits and Jira decisions replaced that representation: FHIR-10544 introduced the Encounter.diagnosis backbone, FHIR-14758 removed the redundant primaryDiagnosis extension, and FHIR-25215 removed remaining stale primaryDiagnosis comments.
additional_context: FHIR-16148 redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis for R5, FHIR-38784 allowed repeated reason/use classifications, FHIR-19285 moved billing-oriented diagnosis ranking to Account.diagnosis.sequence, and FHIR-38807 corrected remaining stale Encounter reason/diagnosis wording. Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, so the current StructureDefinition is in build scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Encounter.reason.value supports reason/admitting diagnosis concepts where appropriate, Encounter.diagnosis.condition and Encounter.diagnosis.use support conditions addressed during the encounter and their role/use, and Account.diagnosis.sequence carries the billing rank formerly represented by the positiveInt extension.

related_jiras.note: Another DSTU1 Encounter diagnosis issue applied in the same 0983925cea commit and using the same primaryDiagnosis extension approach.
Replaced Encounter.indication and redundant Encounter diagnosis extensions with the core Encounter.diagnosis backbone.

Redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis into the current R5 model.
Moved billing diagnosis ranking from Encounter to Account.diagnosis.sequence.
Removed stale references to the deleted primaryDiagnosis extension.
Made Encounter.reason.use and Encounter.diagnosis.use repeat for multiple classifications.
Already represented on the combined branch and corrected remaining Encounter reason/diagnosis wording.
